exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures of food and drinks. Which are: healthy, low-fat foods; fatty foods; junk food?
exercises.instructionUz: Ovqat va ichimliklar suratlariga qarang. Qaysilari: sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlar; yog'li ovqatlar; foydasiz ovqat?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh TOIFA.


⚠ 'HEALTHY, LOW-FAT FOODS':

  = sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlar.
  Betdan: melon, cucumber,
  watermelon, mushrooms, peaches,
  carrot juice, apple juice,
  lettuce, fruit salad, green beans,
  peas, prawns, mussels, yoghurt
  (low fat), grilled chicken,
  wholemeal bread, broccoli


⚠ 'FATTY FOODS':

  = yog'li ovqatlar.
  Betdan: fried chicken, sausages,
  bacon, chocolate cake, doughnut,
  nuts, olive oil, French toast,
  garlic bread


⚠ 'JUNK FOOD':

  = foydasiz, tez tayyor ovqat.
  Betdan: club sandwich with chips,
  doughnut, bacon & cheese sandwich


⚠ 'FOOD' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  ⚠ 'Food IS expensive.' (BIRLIK
  fe'l)
  ⚠ Lekin 'foods' = turli xil
  ovqatlar (turlar haqida
  gapirganda) - mashqda ham shunday.


⚠ 'JUNK':

  = axlat, keraksiz narsa.
  ⚠ 'junk food' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  'junk foods' XATO.


⚠ 'FATTY' va 'FAT':

  fat = semiz (odam) yoki yog' (ot)
  fatty = yog'li (ovqat)

  ⚠ 'a fat food' - XATO,
  'a fatty food' ✓


⚠ 'LOW-FAT':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (sifat vazifasida).
  ⚠ Aksi: 'full-fat' yoki 'high-fat'.

exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'A VEGETARIAN':

  = go'sht yemaydigan odam.
  ⚠ Lekin tuxum, sut, pishloq yeydi.
  ⚠ 'a vegan' = umuman hayvon
  mahsulotlarini yemaydigan.


⚠ 'TO BE ON A DIET':

  = parhezda bo'lmoq (ozish uchun).
  ⚠ 'ON a diet' - 'on' predlogi
  ShART.
  ⚠ 'to go on a diet' = parhezga
  o'tirmoq.


⚠ 'A DIET' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) parhez (ozish uchun)
  2) ovqatlanish tarzi (umuman)
     'a healthy diet' = sog'lom
     ovqatlanish

  ⚠ 3c mashqida IKKINChI ma'noda.


⚠ 'SUITABLE FOR':

  = ... uchun mos.
  ⚠ 'suitable TO' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'to suit' = mos kelmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
SUHBAT SAVOLLARI.


⚠ 'AT WORK' va 'AT SCHOOL':

  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ! Chunki MAQSAD ko'zda
  tutilyapti (ishlash, o'qish).
  ⚠ 37-38-betlarda 'at university'
  ham shunday edi.


⚠ 'ON A PICNIC':

  ⚠ 'on' predlogi - 38-betdagi
  23-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'A FAST-FOOD RESTAURANT':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (sifat vazifasida).
  ⚠ 'fast food' (ot) - defissiz.


⚠ 'AN EXPENSIVE RESTAURANT':

  ⚠ 'AN' - chunki 'expensive' UNLI
  bilan boshlanadi.


⚠ 'A SNACK BETWEEN MEALS':

  = ovqatlar orasida yengil tamaddi.
  ⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish
  (nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqat).
  ⚠ 36-betdagi 14-mashqda 'have a
  snack' bor edi.


⚠ 'A FUSSY EATER':

  = injiq yeguvchi (ko'p narsani
  yemaydigan).
  ⚠ 'fussy' = injiq, tanlab
  yeydigan.


⚠ 'TO CONTAIN':

  = o'z ichiga olmoq, tarkibida
  bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'to contain' - PREDLOGSIZ.


⚠ 'RICH IN':

  = ... ga boy.
  ⚠ 'rich IN vitamins' - 'in'
  predlogi ShART.
  ⚠ 'rich of' - XATO.


⚠ 'CALORIES', 'PROTEIN', 'VITAMINS':

  ⚠ 'a calorie' - SANALADIGAN.
  ⚠ 'protein' - SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'a vitamin' - SANALADIGAN.
  ⚠ 'vitamin' Britaniyada /ˈvɪtəmɪn/,
  AQShda /ˈvaɪtəmɪn/.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI MAQOLADA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  ON film sets
     - kino maydonchalarida
  ON a diet
     - parhezda
  ninety-nine per cent OF the time
     - vaqtning 99 foizida
  to insist ON sth
     - qat'iy talab qilmoq
  to worry ABOUT sth
     - xavotir olmoq
  to cook FOR sb
     - kimgadir ovqat pishirmoq
  to complain ABOUT sth
     - shikoyat qilmoq
  to think ABOUT sth
     - o'ylamoq


⚠ 'ABOUT' - UCh FE'L BILAN:

  worry about, complain about,
  think about
  ⚠ Yana: 'wonder about' (5-mashq).


⚠ 'TO INSIST ON':

  ⚠ 'ON' + -ING yoki ot:
     'insist ON eating'
     'insist ON fresh juice'
  ⚠ 'insist TO' - XATO!


⚠ 'TO COOK FOR SB':

  ⚠ 'cook TO sb' - XATO.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'buy sth FOR sb',
  'make sth FOR sb'.


⚠ 'TO THINK ABOUT' va 'TO THINK OF':

  think about = o'ylab ko'rmoq
     (uzoq, chuqur)
  think of = eslamoq, tasavvur
     qilmoq

  ⚠ 'What do you THINK OF it?' =
  Bu haqda fikring qanday?


⚠ 'SB' va 'STH':

  sb = somebody (kimdir)
  sth = something (nimadir)
  ⚠ Lug'atlarda ishlatiladigan
  qisqartmalar.


⚠ 'PER CENT':

  ⚠ Britaniyada AJRATIB: 'per cent'.
  ⚠ AQShda QO'ShIB: 'percent'.
  ⚠ '99 per cent OF the time'.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'ON a film set' - 'on' predlogi.
⚠ Maqolada: 'Chefs and caterers ON FILM SETS'.

⚠ 'ON a diet' - 'on' predlogi ShART.
⚠ 'in a diet' - XATO.

⚠ 'per cent OF' - 'of' predlogi.
⚠ Britaniyada 'per cent' AJRATIB yoziladi.

⚠ 'to insist ON' + -ING yoki ot.
⚠ 'insist to' - XATO!

⚠ 'to worry ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'worry for' - XATO.

⚠ 'to cook FOR sb' - 'for' predlogi.
⚠ 'cook to sb' - XATO.

⚠ 'to complain ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ To'liq: 'complain TO sb ABOUT sth'.

⚠ 'to think ABOUT' + -ING.
⚠ 'think OF' = eslamoq, tasavvur qilmoq -
biroz boshqa ma'no.

exercises.explanationUz:
MA'NODOShLARNI ALMAShTIRISh.

RO'YXAT: constantly, fatty,
         wondered about, insists on


JAVOBLAR:

  1 asked yourself → WONDERED ABOUT
  2 continuously → CONSTANTLY
  3 demands → INSISTS ON
  4 fattening → FATTY


⚠ 3-BANDGA DIQQAT - ShAKL:

  'Dad always DEMANDS a cup of hot
   milk'
  → 'Dad always INSISTS ON a cup of
     hot milk'

  ⚠ 'demand' PREDLOGSIZ, lekin
  'insist' 'ON' bilan!
  ⚠ Shakl ham 3-shaxs birlik:
  'insistS'.


⚠ 'CONSTANTLY' va 'CONTINUOUSLY':

  constantly = doimo, tez-tez
     takrorlanib
  continuously = uzluksiz,
     to'xtovsiz

  ⚠ Bu yerda deyarli bir xil.


⚠ 'FATTY' va 'FATTENING':

  fatty = yog'li (tarkibida yog'
     ko'p)
  fattening = semirtiruvchi

  ⚠ Deyarli bir xil, lekin
  'fattening' NATIJAga urg'u beradi.


⚠ 'A DIETER':

  = parhezdagi odam.
  ⚠ 'diet' + '-er'.


⚠ 'DAMAGE':

  = zarar.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN!
  ⚠ 'to do damage TO sth' = zarar
  yetkazmoq.


⚠ 'SLIM':

  = nozik, xushbichim.
  ⚠ 'thin' dan ijobiyroq.
  ⚠ 'to stay slim' = nozik qolmoq.


⚠ 'BEDTIME':

  = uxlash vaqti.
  ⚠ QO'ShIB yoziladi.
  ⚠ 'before bedtime' - artiklsiz.

╔══════════════════════════════════╗

⚠ 'AN OVEN':

⚠ 'A PAN':

exercises.explanationUz:

TARJIMASI bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ MAQOLA HAQIDA:

  Ikki oshpaz-ta'minotchi (John Sharp
  va Susan Tate) kino yulduzlarining
  ovqatlanish odatlari haqida
  gapiradi.


⚠ QALIN SO'ZLAR - 5-MAShQDA
  TUShUNTIRILADI:

  dating, wondered about, chefs,
  caterers, film sets, eating habits,
  strict, constantly on a diet,
  insist on, filming, steamed,
  worry about, fixed, complain about,
  sits, snack


⚠ 'A STAR' bu yerda:

  = mashhur aktyor/aktrisa.


⚠ MAQOLADAGI ISMLAR:

  John Sharp - oshpaz (chef)
  Susan Tate - ta'minotchi (caterer)
  Demi Moore, Helen Hunt,
  Eddie Murphy, Whoopi Goldberg,
  Bill Murray, Mickey Rourke -
  kino yulduzlari
  Michelle Pfeiffer, Al Pacino -
  yana ikki yulduz

  ⚠ 'Now and Then' va 'Twister' -
  filmlar nomi (QIYa harflarda).

tasks.en: What Do The Stars Eat?
Film stars are everyone's favourite subject. People love to talk about what they're wearing, who they're dating, and how much money they make. But have you ever wondered about what they eat?
tasks.uz: Kino yulduzlari - hammaning sevimli mavzusi. Odamlar ular nima kiyayotgani, kim bilan uchrashayotgani va qancha pul ishlayotgani haqida gapirishni yaxshi ko'radi. Lekin ular nima yeydi deb hech o'ylab ko'rganmisiz?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to date sb' = kim bilandir uchrashmoq
(sevishganlar).
⚠ 'to wonder about' = qiziqmoq, o'ylab ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'to make money' = pul ishlamoq.

tasks.en: Chefs and caterers on film sets have the answers. "Every actor has different eating habits," says chef John Sharp.
tasks.uz: Kino maydonchalaridagi oshpazlar va ta'minotchilarda javob bor. "Har bir aktyorning ovqatlanish odatlari har xil", - deydi oshpaz Jon Sharp.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a chef' = professional oshpaz (/ʃef/).
⚠ 'a caterer' = ovqat bilan ta'minlovchi.
⚠ 'a film set' = kino suratga olish maydonchasi.

tasks.en: "Some stars love meat, while others are strict vegetarians who don't eat meat, eggs, or fish. Some stars love junk food, while others are constantly on a diet and eat only healthy foods."
tasks.uz: "Ba'zi yulduzlar go'shtni yaxshi ko'radi, boshqalari esa go'sht, tuxum va baliq yemaydigan qat'iy vegetarianlar. Ba'zi yulduzlar foydasiz ovqatni yaxshi ko'radi, boshqalari esa doim parhezda va faqat sog'lom ovqat yeydi".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'strict' = qat'iy.
⚠ 'constantly' = doimo.
⚠ 'while' bu yerda = holbuki, esa
(qarama-qarshilik).

tasks.en: Ninety-nine per cent of the time, actresses are on a diet and insist on eating only low-fat foods.
tasks.uz: Vaqtning to'qson to'qqiz foizida aktrisalar parhezda bo'lib, faqat kam yog'li ovqat yeyishni talab qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'per cent OF the time' - 'of' predlogi.
⚠ 'to insist ON' + -ING.

tasks.en: During the filming of Now and Then, Demi Moore ate nothing but Basmati rice, steamed baby spinach, green beans with lemon, and turkey sandwiches on wholemeal bread.
tasks.uz: 'Now and Then' filmini suratga olish paytida Demi Mur faqat basmati guruch, bug'da pishirilgan yosh ismaloq, limonli yashil loviya va to'liq donli nondagi kurka sendvichlarini yedi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'nothing but' = faqat, boshqa hech narsa.
⚠ 'steamed' = bug'da pishirilgan.
⚠ 'a sandwich ON wholemeal bread' - 'on'
predlogi.

tasks.en: During the filming of Twister, Helen Hunt only ate low-calorie foods, including poached eggs, dry toast, and steamed brown rice with vegetables.
tasks.uz: 'Twister' filmini suratga olish paytida Helen Xant faqat kam kaloriyali ovqat yedi: suvda pishirilgan tuxum, quruq tost va sabzavotli bug'da pishirilgan jigarrang guruch.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'low-calorie' - DEFIS bilan.
⚠ 'dry toast' = sariyog'siz tost.
⚠ 'including' = ... jumladan.

tasks.en: Other stars love to eat junk food, and never count calories during their meals. Eddie Murphy's favourite food is Kentucky Fried Chicken.
tasks.uz: Boshqa yulduzlar foydasiz ovqat yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi va ovqat paytida hech qachon kaloriya sanamaydi. Eddi Merfining sevimli taomi - Kentucky Fried Chicken.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to count calories' = kaloriya sanamoq.
⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish.

tasks.en: Whoopi Goldberg doesn't worry about how healthy her diet is, and loves fatty bacon sandwiches with lettuce, mayonnaise and lots of butter.
tasks.uz: Vupi Goldberg ovqatlanishi qanchalik sog'lomligidan xavotir olmaydi va salat bargi, mayonez va ko'p sariyog' bilan yog'li bekonli sendvichlarni yaxshi ko'radi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to worry ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'butter' - SANALMAYDIGAN → 'LOTS OF butter'.

tasks.en: One thing for sure is that cooking for the stars is never easy, because they are often fussy eaters.
tasks.uz: Aniq bir narsa: yulduzlarga ovqat pishirish hech qachon oson emas, chunki ular ko'pincha injiq yeguvchilar.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'for sure' = aniq.
⚠ 'to cook FOR sb' - 'for' predlogi.
⚠ 'a fussy eater' - 40-betda ham bor edi.

tasks.en: "They want food fixed exactly the way they like it and always have something to complain about," says caterer Susan Tate.
tasks.uz: "Ular ovqat aynan o'zlari xohlagandek tayyorlanishini istaydi va doim shikoyat qiladigan narsa topadi", - deydi ta'minotchi Syuzan Teyt.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'fixed' bu yerda = tayyorlangan (AQSh usuli).
⚠ 'to complain ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'the way they like it' = o'zlari xohlagandek.

tasks.en: Bill Murray won't eat watermelon with seeds in it, and Mickey Rourke insists on freshly-squeezed carrot juice twice a day, but he won't drink it if it sits for more than six minutes.
tasks.uz: Bill Marrey urug'li tarvuzni yemaydi, Mikki Rurk esa kuniga ikki marta yangi siqilgan sabzi sharbatini talab qiladi, lekin agar u olti daqiqadan ortiq tursa, ichmaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ "won't" bu yerda = QAT'IY rad etish
('will' ning bu ma'nosi ham bor).
⚠ 'to sit' bu yerda = turmoq, qolmoq.

tasks.en: Cooking for the stars is hard work, but few of these caterers ever think about changing jobs. "I love my work," says Susan Tate.
tasks.uz: Yulduzlarga ovqat pishirish - og'ir mehnat, lekin bu ta'minotchilarning ozchiligi ish almashtirish haqida o'ylaydi. "Men ishimni yaxshi ko'raman", - deydi Syuzan Teyt.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'FEW' (artiklsiz) = juda oz (salbiy ma'no).
⚠ 'A few' = bir nechta (ijobiy).
⚠ 'to think ABOUT' + -ING.

tasks.en: "Where else can I see what Michelle Pfeiffer eats for breakfast or what Al Pacino has for a snack?"
tasks.uz: "Michelle Pfeiffer nonushtaga nima yeyishini yoki Al Pachino tamaddiga nima olishini yana qayerda ko'ra olaman?"
tasks.note:
⚠ 'for breakfast' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'for A snack' - artikl BOR.
⚠ 'to have sth for a snack' = tamaddiga
nimadir olmoq.

tasks.en: Mr Harris visited Monty's fast-food restaurant to write a report about its good and bad points.

tasks.en: [1 Introduction] The purpose of this report is to assess the new Monty's fast-food restaurant in Chester, which I visited on 28th June.

hisobotning STANDART boshlanishi.

tasks.en: [2 Food & Prices] There is a varied menu at Monty's which includes a fantastic salad bar, a wide choice of vegetarian dishes and five types of delicious hamburgers.
tasks.uz: [2 Ovqat va narxlar] Monty's da turli-tuman menyu bor: ajoyib salat bo'limi, vegetarian taomlarning keng tanlovi va besh xil mazali gamburger.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.
⚠ 'five types OF hamburgers'.

tasks.en: I tried the Mexican Sizzler - a spicy hamburger with chilli sauce in a soft, white bread roll. It was very tasty. However, it was rather cold. I also thought that Monty's was a bit too expensive.
tasks.uz: Men 'Mexican Sizzler'ni tatib ko'rdim - yumshoq oq bulochkada chili sousli achchiq gamburger. Juda mazali edi. Biroq, ancha sovuq edi. Menimcha, Monty's biroz qimmatroq ham edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'spicy' = achchiq (ziravorli).
⚠ 'However' - YoMON tomonga o'tish.
⚠ 'rather cold', 'a bit too expensive' -
yumshatilgan tanqid.

tasks.en: [3 Service] The Monty's staff were helpful, friendly and polite during my visit. They looked very smart in their clean uniforms. Unfortunately, the service was rather slow and one of the cashiers gave me the wrong change.
tasks.uz: [3 Xizmat] Tashrifim davomida Monty's xodimlari yordamchi, samimiy va muloyim edi. Toza formalarida juda chiroyli ko'rinardi. Afsuski, xizmat ancha sekin edi va kassirlardan biri qaytimni noto'g'ri berdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'The staff WERE' - jamoa oti, ko'plik fe'l.
⚠ 'Unfortunately' = afsuski.
⚠ 'change' bu yerda = qaytim pul.
⚠ 'a cashier' = kassir.

tasks.en: [4 Atmosphere] The friendly staff, good music, clean tables, and comfortable seating all helped to give Monty's an excellent atmosphere. The new no-smoking policy is also a good idea, and it made my meal at Monty's a very pleasurable experience.
tasks.uz: [4 Muhit] Samimiy xodimlar, yaxshi musiqa, toza stollar va qulay o'rindiqlar - hammasi Monty's ga ajoyib muhit berdi. Yangi chekish taqiqi ham yaxshi fikr va u Monty's dagi ovqatimni juda yoqimli tajribaga aylantirdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'atmosphere' = muhit, /ˈætməsfɪə/.
⚠ 'pleasurable' = yoqimli (rasmiy).
⚠ 'to help TO give' - 'help' dan keyin 'to'
ixtiyoriy.

tasks.en: [5 Conclusion] The new Monty's restaurant in Chester is, on the whole, a great success. However, I think that the manager should make a few improvements.
tasks.uz: [5 Xulosa] Chesterdagi yangi Monty's restorani, umuman olganda, katta muvaffaqiyat. Biroq, menimcha, menejer bir nechta yaxshilanish kiritishi kerak.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'on the whole' = umuman olganda.
⚠ 'SHOULD make' - tavsiya uchun modal fe'l
(18b savoli).
⚠ 'an improvement' = yaxshilanish.

tasks.en: Firstly, he should make sure that all hot dishes are hot when they go out to customers. Secondly, he should lower the prices, as they are too high for a fast-food restaurant. Finally, he should improve staff training, so that the staff work faster and make fewer mistakes.
tasks.uz: Birinchidan, u barcha issiq taomlar mijozlarga chiqarilganda issiq bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qilishi kerak. Ikkinchidan, narxlarni tushirishi kerak, chunki ular tez ovqat restorani uchun juda yuqori. Nihoyat, xodimlar tayyorgarligini yaxshilashi kerak, shunda xodimlar tezroq ishlaydi va kamroq xato qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to make sure that' = ishonch hosil qilmoq.
⚠ 'to lower' = tushirmoq (narxni).
⚠ 'FEWER mistakes' - sanaladigan ot bilan
'fewer' ('less' EMAS!).
⚠ 'so that' = shunda, ... uchun.

exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi qaysi so'zlar a; an; some bilan keladi? Qaysilari sanaladigan? Qaysilari sanalmaydigan?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh GURUH.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'A' + SANALADIGAN BIRLIK        ║
║  (undosh tovush)                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  a hamburger, a banana,
  a jacket potato, a hot dog,
  a biscuit, a peach


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'AN' + SANALADIGAN BIRLIK       ║
║  (unli tovush)                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  an apple, an apricot


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'SOME' + KO'PLIK yoki           ║
║  SANALMAYDIGAN                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'PLIK (sanaladigan):
     some sweets, some chips,
     some chocolates, some eggs,
     some grapes

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     some pasta, some orange juice,
     some tea, some coffee,
     some milk, some bacon


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  SANALADIGAN → 'a/an' (birlikda),
     '-s' (ko'plikda)
  SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a/an' YO'Q,
     '-s' YO'Q, 'some' bilan

  ⚠ 'a milk' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'milks' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'some milk' ✓


⚠ 'A' yoki 'AN'?

  ⚠ TOVUShga qarab, HARFga emas!
     an Apple (a - unli)
     an Apricot (a - unli)
     a Hamburger (h - undosh)
     a Hot dog (h - undosh)

  ⚠ 'a Uniform' - 'u' /juː/ deb
  o'qilgani uchun 'a' (35-betda
  ham bor edi).


⚠ 'PASTA' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  ⚠ 'a pasta' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'a plate of pasta' ✓


⚠ 'GRAPES' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA:

  ⚠ 'a grape' bitta uzum donasi -
  kam ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ 'some grapes' = bir bosh uzum.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Would you like SOME BACON?
  SB: Yes, please. And can I have
      SOME CHIPS, too?
  SA: Of course. Do you want A PEACH?
  SB: No, thanks. I'd rather have
      AN APPLE.


⚠ "I'D RATHER HAVE ...":

  = ... ni afzal ko'raman.
  ⚠ "I'd rather" = 'I would rather'.
  ⚠ Keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l:
  "I'd rather HAVE" ✓
  "I'd rather to have" - XATO!

exercises.explanationUz:
MIQDOR SO'ZLARI - TO'LIQ TIZIM.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SOME - TASDIQ gaplarda          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  sanalmaydigan + KO'PLIK bilan

  'There is SOME spinach left.'

║  ANY - SAVOL va INKORda          ║

  sanalmaydigan + KO'PLIK bilan

  'Are there ANY biscuits?'
  "There isn't ANY milk."
  'Is there ANY salt?'
  "There aren't ANY potatoes."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MANY - SANALADIGAN bilan        ║
║  (savol va inkorda)              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'How MANY eggs are there?'
  "There aren't MANY rolls left."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MUCH - SANALMAYDIGAN bilan      ║
║  (savol va inkorda)              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'How MUCH butter is there?'
  "There isn't MUCH sugar left."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  A FEW / A LITTLE                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  A FEW + SANALADIGAN ko'plik
     'There are A FEW eggs in the
      bowl.' (some; not many)

  A LITTLE + SANALMAYDIGAN
     'There is A LITTLE coffee in
      the pot.' (some; not much)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ESLAB QOLISh JADVALI            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT BERISh - SHOULD.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  should + FE'L (to SIZ)
  ⚠ BARCha shaxsda bir xil:
     I/you/he/she/we/they SHOULD
  ⚠ 'He shouldS' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'should TO drink' - XATO!

  INKOR: shouldn't (= should not)
  SAVOL: Should I ...? /
         What should I do?


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  should = ... qilgan ma'qul,
           ... qilish kerak (maslahat)
  shouldn't = ... qilmagan ma'qul

  'You SHOULD drink a lot of water
   daily.' (= yaxshi fikr)
  'You SHOULDN'T drink too much
   coffee.' (= yomon fikr)


⚠ 'SHOULD' va 'MUST' FARQI:

  should = MASLAHAT (bajarish
     ixtiyoriy)
  must = MAJBURIYaT (bajarish shart)

  'You should see a doctor.' -
     maslahat beraman
  'You must see a doctor.' -
     boshqa iloj yo'q


⚠ 'SHOULD' O'QILIShI:

  /ʃʊd/ - 'l' O'QILMAYDI!
  ⚠ 'shouldn't' /ˈʃʊdnt/.


⚠ 'DAILY':

  = har kuni.
  ⚠ 'every day' bilan bir xil.
  ⚠ 'weekly' (har hafta),
  'monthly' (har oy).


⚠ 'I.E.':

  = ya'ni (lotincha 'id est').
  ⚠ 'e.g.' = masalan - ADAShTIRMANG.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI QISQA SUHBAT.

  ⚠ Audio bor, lekin JAVOB MATNDAN
  ANIQ: ovqat turi va uslub joyni
  ochib beradi.


JAVOBLAR:

  QIMMAT RESTORAN: 1, 3, 6
     1 - 'madam', 'starter',
         'main course', 'grilled trout'
     3 - 'wine list', 'house red'
     6 - 'Could I have the bill'

  TEZ OVQAT RESTORANI: 2, 4, 5
     2 - 'cheeseburger'
     4 - 'Diet Coke'
     5 - 'Anything else? How much is
          that?' (kassada)


⚠ RESTORAN LUG'ATI:

  to order = buyurtma bermoq
  a starter = birinchi taom
     (salat, sho'rva)
  the main course = asosiy taom
  a dessert = shirinlik
  the wine list = vino ro'yxati
  the house red = restoranning o'z
     qizil vinosi
  the bill = hisob (Britaniya)


⚠ MULOYIM ILTIMOS:

  'Can I have ...?' - oddiy
  'Could I have ...?' - MULOYIMROQ
  "I'll have ..." - buyurtma berishda
     eng odatiy


⚠ 'ARE YOU READY TO ORDER?':

  = Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz?
  ⚠ Ofitsiantning standart savoli.


⚠ 'ANYTHING ELSE?':

  = Yana biror narsa?
  ⚠ 'else' = yana, boshqa.


⚠ 'GRILLED TROUT':

  = panjarada pishirilgan gulmohi.
  ⚠ 'trout' - ko'pligi ham 'trout'.


⚠ 'A DIET COKE':

  = shakarsiz Koka-kola.
  ⚠ 'A Diet Coke' - bir shisha/stakan
  ma'nosida sanaladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
TAKLIF QILISh, QABUL QILISh, RAD
ETISh.


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  1 A: WOULD YOU LIKE something to
       eat?
    B: Yes, please. I'm starving.
    A: Well, we've got sandwiches.
       Would you prefer tuna or
       cheese?
    B: I'D LIKE a cheese sandwich,
       please.

  2 A: WOULD YOU LIKE a hot dog,
       Steve?
    B: No, thanks. I'm not very
       hungry.
    A: WHAT ABOUT a salad, then?
    B: No, thanks. Just a Diet Coke,
       please.


⚠ TAKLIF QILISh:

  Would you like ...?
  What about ...? / How about ...?
  Would you prefer A or B?


⚠ QABUL QILISh:

  Yes, please.
  I'd like ..., please.


⚠ RAD ETISh:

  No, thanks. I'm not very hungry.
  ⚠ Rad etganda SABAB aytish
  muloyimlik belgisi.


⚠ "I'M STARVING":

  = ochlikdan o'lyapman (juda och).
  ⚠ 'to starve' = och qolmoq.
  ⚠ So'zlashuvda 'very hungry'
  o'rniga.


⚠ 'WOULD YOU PREFER ...?':

  = qaysinisini afzal ko'rasiz?
  ⚠ 'to prefer' = afzal ko'rmoq.


⚠ 'TUNA':

  = tunets baliq.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈtjuːnə/.


⚠ 'THEN' GAP OXIRIDA:

  'What about a salad, THEN?'
  = Unda salat-chi?
  ⚠ 'then' bu yerda = unda, bo'lmasa.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'Would you like ...?' - muloyim taklif.
⚠ Javob 'Yes, please' - taklif qabul qilindi.

⚠ "I'd like" = 'I would like' - muloyim.
⚠ Savolga mos javob: 'Would you like' → "I'd like".

⚠ 'Would you like a hot dog?'
⚠ Javob 'No, thanks' - rad etildi.

⚠ 'What about ...?' / 'How about ...?' -
boshqa variant taklif qilish.
⚠ 'then' = unda.

sections.title: Writing (a report about the good and bad points of a place)
sections.titleUz: Yozish (joyning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari haqida hisobot)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a report about the good and bad points of a place such as a restaurant, a campsite, a hotel, etc, we can divide it into three parts.
exercises.instructionUz: Restoran, lager, mehmonxona kabi joyning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari haqida hisobot yozganda uni uch qismga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
HISOBOT YoZISh QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  UCh QISM                        ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) INTRODUCTION (kirish) -
     hisobot MAQSADI:
     'The purpose of this report is
      to assess ...'

  2) MAIN BODY (asosiy qism) -
     yaxshi va yomon tomonlar
     MISOLLAR bilan, har biri
     KIChIK SARLAVHA ostida:
     Food & Prices / Service /
     Atmosphere

  3) CONCLUSION (xulosa) -
     UMUMIY TAASSUROT va
     TAKLIFLAR ('should')


⚠ ZAMON:

  Hozirgi yoki o'tgan zamon - ikkalasi
  ham mumkin.
  ⚠ 44-betdagi hisobotda ikkalasi
  aralash: 'There IS a varied menu'
  (hozirgi) / 'It WAS very tasty'
  (o'tgan - tashrif paytida).


⚠ 'A SUBHEADING':

  = kichik sarlavha.
  ⚠ 'sub-' = ost, kichik.


⚠ 'OVERALL IMPRESSION':

  = umumiy taassurot.
  ⚠ 'overall' = umumiy.
  ⚠ 'an impression' = taassurot.


⚠ 'A CAMPSITE':

  = lager joyi (chodir tikiladigan).

tasks.en: When we write a report about the good and bad points of a place such as a restaurant, a campsite, a hotel, etc, we can divide it into three parts.
tasks.uz: Restoran, lager, mehmonxona kabi joyning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari haqida hisobot yozganda uni uch qismga bo'lishimiz mumkin.

tasks.en: the introduction, where we state the purpose of our report;
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to state' = bayon qilmoq.
⚠ 'The purpose of this report is to ...'

tasks.en: the main body, where we talk about the good and bad points with examples. We write each piece of information under subheadings.
tasks.uz: asosiy qism - yaxshi va yomon tomonlar haqida misollar bilan gapiramiz. Har bir ma'lumotni kichik sarlavhalar ostida yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a piece of information' - 'information'
SANALMAYDIGAN.
⚠ 'a subheading' = kichik sarlavha.

tasks.en: the conclusion, where we give our overall impression and make our suggestions.
tasks.uz: xulosa - umumiy taassurotimizni beramiz va takliflarimizni aytamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to MAKE a suggestion' - 'do' EMAS.
⚠ Takliflar 'should' bilan.

tasks.en: We can use present tenses or past tenses for this kind of report.
tasks.uz: Bunday hisobotda hozirgi yoki o'tgan zamonni ishlatishimiz mumkin.

⚠ 'to wonder ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Others are constantly on a diet and eat only healthy foods.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshqalari doimo parhezda va faqat sog'lom ovqat yeydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mickey Rourke insists on freshly-squeezed carrot juice.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mikki Rurk yangi siqilgan sabzi sharbatini talab qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to insist ON' - PREDLOG ShART.
⚠ 'insist to' - XATO!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Whoopi Goldberg doesn't worry about how healthy her diet is.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Vupi Goldberg ovqatlanishi qanchalik sog'lomligidan xavotir olmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Demi Moore enjoys Basmati rice.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Demi Mur basmati guruchni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'enjoy' dan keyin OT yoki -ING.
⚠ 'enjoy TO eat' - XATO!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bill Murray won't eat watermelon with seeds in it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bill Marrey urug'li tarvuzni yemaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "won't" bu yerda = QAT'IY RAD ETISh,
kelasi zamon emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is some spinach left. / There are some carrots in the fridge.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biroz ismaloq qolgan. / Muzlatgichda bir nechta sabzi bor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are there any biscuits? / Is there any salt?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pechenye bormi? / Tuz bormi?

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many eggs are there? / How much butter is there?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nechta tuxum bor? / Qancha sariyog' bor?

sentencePatterns.formula: There are a few + [sanaladigan]. / There is a little + [sanalmaydigan].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are a few eggs in the bowl. / There is a little coffee in the pot.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kosada bir nechta tuxum bor. / Choynakda biroz qahva bor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like some bacon?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bekon xohlaysizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TAKLIFda savol bo'lsa ham 'SOME'!
⚠ 'any' bu yerda MOS EMAS.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, thanks. I'd rather have an apple.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, rahmat. Olmani afzal ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "I'd rather" dan keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l.
⚠ "I'd rather to have" - XATO!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a bar of chocolate, a carton of milk, a slice of bread
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: shokolad plitkasi, karton quti sut, bir tilim non
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Sanalmaydigan otni SANASh usuli.
⚠ Har mahsulotning O'Z idish so'zi bor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should wash your hands before cooking.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ovqat pishirishdan oldin qo'l yuvishingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'should' + fe'l, 'to' SIZ; barcha shaxsda bir xil.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'll have [taom] as a starter, and [taom] for the main course.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'll have the mushroom soup as a starter, and the grilled trout for the main course.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Birinchi taomga qo'ziqorinli sho'rva, asosiy taomga gulmohi olaman.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Could I have the bill, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hisobni bering, iltimos.

sentencePatterns.formula: Would you like [nima]? - Yes, please. / No, thanks.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like a hot dog? - No, thanks. I'm not very hungry.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xot-dog xohlaysizmi? - Yo'q, rahmat. Unchalik och emasman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Taklif → 'Yes, please' / 'No, thanks'.
⚠ Rad etganda sabab aytish muloyim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What about a salad, then?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Unda salat-chi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Boshqa variant taklif qilish.
⚠ 'then' gap oxirida = unda.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Firstly, a good restaurant should have fast service. However, it should not have high prices.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Birinchidan, yaxshi restoranda tez xizmat bo'lishi kerak. Biroq, yuqori narxlar bo'lmasligi kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: The purpose of this report is to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The purpose of this report is to assess the new restaurant.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu hisobotning maqsadi - yangi restoranni baholash.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He should lower the prices, as they are too high.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U narxlarni tushirishi kerak, chunki ular juda yuqori.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The new restaurant is, on the whole, a great success.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yangi restoran, umuman olganda, katta muvaffaqiyat.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like eating vegetables.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sabzavot yeyishni yoqtiraman.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'd like some fresh orange juice, please. / We'd like to have dinner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yangi apelsin sharbati olardim. / Kechki ovqat qilishni xohlardik.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ HOZIR xohlash, muloyim so'rov.
⚠ "'d like" + TO + fe'l (-ING EMAS!).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The wine tasted like vinegar.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Vino sirkaga o'xshardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to taste LIKE' = ... ta'mida bo'lmoq.
⚠ 'look like', 'sound like' ham shunday.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: On the whole, Romano's is a very good restaurant. However, the manager should start a no-smoking policy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Umuman olganda, Romano's juda yaxshi restoran. Biroq, menejer chekish taqiqini boshlashi kerak.
